title: Wonder of Wonders
lyrics_original: Long before I ever knew Him,
Not that I first did choose Him,
Still this heart would refuse Him
Had He left it to me!
I'd still bar the heart's door

bible_verses.english: But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
but God, being rich in mercy, for his great love with which he loved us, even when we were dead through our trespasses, made us alive together with Christ (by grace you have been saved),

By this God’s love was revealed in us, that God has sent his only begotten Son into the world that we might live through him. In this is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.

devotional.prayer_english: Heavenly Father, I am overwhelmed by the wonder of Your love for me. Long before I ever sought You, You pursued my heart and offered mercy through Your Son, Jesus. Thank You for loving me even in my weakest and most broken moments. Help me to rest securely in Your grace today and to reflect Your incredible love to those around me. In Jesus' name, Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: It is breathtaking to consider that before we even knew our need for a Savior, God loved us with an everlasting love. The Gospel turns our self-reliance upside down, revealing that grace is not earned by our goodness, but freely poured out through Christ's sacrifice. As you sing this song, let your heart rest in the profound wonder of being fully known and completely loved. May it move you to step into His presence today with humble gratitude.
